}}'''Kirin''' was the daughter of [[Morin]], the first [[Maiden of the Spear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kirin}}{{ref/book|4|25}}

==History==
She was born [[Jenn Aiel]]. At five years old, she was kidnapped by people the Jenn traded with.{{ref/book|4|25}}

Her father already mourned her as being dead, but her mother, [[Morin]], gave up the [[Way of the Leaf]] to rescue her.{{ref/book|4|25}} She was, presumably, rescued and raised [[Aiel]], rather than Jenn.
